promptSuffix: The subjects exist inside the artwork, not in front of it.

translations.Rembrandt: painted in the style of Rembrandt: amber chiaroscuro, glowing faces emerging from deep shadow
translations.Caravaggio: painted in the style of Caravaggio: tenebrism, one hard light slicing through absolute darkness
translations.Velázquez: painted in the style of Velázquez: loose atmospheric brushwork, receding court space, warm shadow
translations.Chagall: painted in the style of Marc Chagall: dreamlike floating lovers, village rooftops, flowers and violins in soft blue, red and green
translations.Vermeer: painted in the style of Vermeer: soft pearly window light, calm domestic stillness
translations.Rubens: painted in the style of Rubens: Baroque swirling movement, rich warm flesh tones, stormy golden skies
translations.Van Gogh: painted in the style of Van Gogh: thick swirling impasto, vivid yellows and blues
translations.Klimt: painted in the style of Klimt: gold leaf, ornamental patterns, flat decorative surfaces
translations.Picasso: painted in the style of Picasso: fragmented Cubist planes, faces seen from several angles at once
translations.Matisse: painted in the style of Matisse: flat bold colour, joyful simplified shapes, pattern on pattern
translations.Modigliani: painted in the style of Modigliani: elongated necks, almond eyes, warm simplified faces
translations.Gauguin: painted in the style of Gauguin: flat saturated colour, bold outlines, tropical simplicity
translations.Toulouse-Lautrec: painted in the style of Toulouse-Lautrec: poster flats, bold sinuous line, Parisian nightlife
translations.Hopper: painted in the style of Edward Hopper: hard light, quiet isolation, American stillness
translations.Kusama: painted in the style of Yayoi Kusama: polka dots everywhere, infinity mirror rooms, bold pumpkin motifs, hypnotic repetition
translations.Warhol: painted in the style of Andy Warhol: silkscreen flat colour, repetition, high-contrast pop
translations.Lichtenstein: painted in the style of Roy Lichtenstein: Ben-Day dots, thick black outline, primary-colour comic panel
translations.Banksy: painted in the style of Banksy: black-and-white stencil, street wall, satirical twist
translations.Mucha: painted in the style of Alphonse Mucha: Art Nouveau poster, flowing hair, floral halo borders
translations.caricature: drawn as satirical caricature: huge heads, exaggerated features, bold ink line
translations.Monet: painted in the style of Monet: Impressionist broken colour, dappled light, shimmering water
translations.Frida Kahlo: painted in the style of Frida Kahlo: Mexican folk surrealism, flowers, flat frontal gaze, symbolic detail
translations.Dalí: painted in the style of Salvador Dalí: melting forms, hyper-real dreamscape, long shadows on barren plains
translations.Magritte: painted in the style of Magritte: deadpan surrealism, floating objects, calm sky and bowler hats
translations.Hokusai: made as a Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print in the style of Hokusai: flat colour, bold outline, Prussian blue
translations.Basquiat: painted in the style of Basquiat: raw neo-expressionist scrawl, crowns, skull-like faces, frantic colour
translations.Keith Haring: painted in the style of Keith Haring: bold black outline figures, radiant lines, dancing pop energy
translations.Tamara de Lempicka: painted in the style of Tamara de Lempicka: Art Deco glamour, polished metallic curves, cool luxury
translations.Leonardo: painted in the style of Leonardo da Vinci: soft sfumato, mysterious smiles, hazy blue landscape
translations.Renoir: painted in the style of Renoir: soft Impressionist glow, dappled light, joyful dances and garden parties
translations.Studio Ghibli: painted in the style of a Studio Ghibli film: soft watercolour backgrounds, warm wonder, gentle anime faces
